parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: A relevant residual changes sign between $x=0.7$ and $x=0.8$ (for example $-0.439\ldots$ and $0.690\ldots$).
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Calculate the value of a relevant expression, or paired expressions, at $x=0.7$ and $x=0.8$; all relevant values are needed, with one error condoned, and pairings must be clear. Work in radians. [M1] Complete the argument with correct values, e.g. $4.95\ldots>4.26\ldots$ and $4.06\ldots<4.49\ldots$, or residuals $-0.439\ldots<0$ and $0.690\ldots>0$. Values rounded or truncated to 2 s.f. are allowed. [A1] Total: 2.

Allow recovery and small last-decimal differences. [A1] Total: 3.
